messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: updated version of AICcmodavg
parts:
Hi,

Just a heads up that the new version of AICcmodavg (2.31) is now on CRAN after fixing a few bugs with certain plots reported by Mike Meredith (Thanks Mike!). Now, all functions that create plots include the arguments cex.lab, cex.axis, and cex.main so the user can customize the size of plot labels, axes, and main title (i.e., mb.gof.test( ), Nmix.gof.test( ), countDist( ), countHist( ), detTime( )).

Functions mb.gof.test( ) and Nmix.gof.test( ) now include an ncores argument so that the user can control how many computer cores are used when parallel processing (parallel = TRUE).

I also added a vignette to illustrate the use of the basic functions of AICcmodavg. You can view the vignette with the command:
> vignette("AICcmodavg")

I hope to include another vignette specific to unmarked later this year.

Best,

Marc
